g.title: x402-payment-flow
g.text: x402 payment flow: every step before, during, and after a paid request
The payer is off by default. An agent without the validator installed cannot pay at all, which is the intended fail-closed state.
Implemented, off or not yet run on testnet
Designed, not built or not deployed

g.title: s1
g.text: RiskModule information check: the lower of
the genome budget and the policy cap

g.title: s2
g.text: Nansen or DeFiLlama only; no open discovery

g.title: s3
g.text: v2 headers only; v1 fails closed as terms
Payload must echo the chosen requirement

g.title: s4
g.text: 4 Claim a nonce slot, then sign
Slot claimed durably in x402_nonce_slots first
No free slot or unlisted terms: no signature

g.title: val
g.text: Payee is on the owner's list
Digest recomputed with from = the account;
a permit or other typed data cannot match

g.title: s6
g.text: Hash recorded only for success on the
configured network by the paying account

g.title: fac
g.text: ERC-1271 acceptance on Monad: open question 1

g.title: s8
g.text: Every 5 minutes by default; matches AuthorizationUsed
and Transfer to a slot and a log entry

g.title: bound
g.text: 26 x 4 x 0.05 = 5.20 USDC per agent per 24 h
A budget separate from the daily cap
